profile.headline: Principal Member Technical Staff, Software Engineer at Salesforce
profile.summary:
* Experience in designing, development and deploying micro-service based applications using Java, Spring, Spring boot frameworks.
* Experience with Kubernetes implementations, Containerization (Docker), DevOps solutions, and scalable micro-services. 
* Competence in Cloud stacks (AWS, GCP).
* Experience with Big Data analytics using Hadoop and tools such as Spark, Pig, Hive, MapReduce, Oozie and Zookeeper.
* Having exposure in various business domains such as Advertisement, Utility, Insurance etc.
* Performed lead role, team co-ordination, back-end developer etc.
